message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the data acquisition path; data is read from CSV and inserted into MongoDB without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: The hardcoded MongoDB connection URL uses plain credentials with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or integrity checks when fetching or pushing data.
No detected label flipping detection: No code compares label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples before data is stored or used.

No detected model integrity verification: The code snippets show no loading of pretrained/serialized model files, and no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are implemented anywhere in the visible pipeline code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training anywhere in the provided snippets.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present in any of the provided code files.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the provided code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or related stress-test logic are present anywhere in the provided code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation in the provided code.

No detected input sanitization: While secure_filename and MAX_CONTENT_PATH are configured, there is no visible input shape/range validation, schema checks, or malformed-input rejection on the inference data-flow path.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline handles tabular ML models (regression, classification, clustering) rather than LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
